verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only event webhooks: Workable notifies a registered external service when candidate events fire, and args can filter which events are sent. That is a developer building block. Any actions would have to be built outside the product, and nothing documents in-product rules (when X happens, do Y). The Workable Agent's automated sourcing and screening is a different feature, not user-defined event-triggered rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You can subscribe to an event and Workable will notify you when it's triggered.
The args object can be used to further filter which candidate events you want to receive.
